subject: pharmacology
title: SGLT2 Inhibitors, Acarbose and Pramlintide: Empagliflozin and Dapagliflozin Beyond Glucose

steps.tx: **Empagliflozin** opened the SGLT2 outcome era when EMPA REG OUTCOME showed cardiovascular death falling by over a third in high risk type 2 diabetes, a result glucose lowering could not explain and every successor trial chased. Blocking proximal tubular glucose and sodium reabsorption wastes 60 to 80 grams of glucose daily in hyperglycaemia, fading as filtration or glucose falls, which makes hypoglycaemia alone nearly impossible and urinary infection the predictable toll.
steps.say: Empagliflozin turned a glucose wasting trick into cardiovascular survival; the bladder pays the subscription.

left.title: SGLT2 mechanism fruits
points: Urinary glucose loss 60 to 80 g daily in hyperglycaemia
Natriuresis and osmotic diuresis: pressure falls modestly
Weight falls 2 to 3 kg, tubuloglomerular feedback restores
Hypoglycaemia essentially impossible alone

right.title: SGLT2 tolls
points: Genital mycotic infections, especially in women
Urinary infections occasionally ascending
Volume depletion in elderly and diuretic users
Euglycaemic ketoacidosis in illness (heart failure lesson)

steps.tx: **Dapagliflozin** carried the class into heart failure and chronic kidney disease with and without diabetes (previous modules), while empagliflozin matched it indication for indication, making agent choice within class a formulary and licensing exercise in most systems. Glycaemic efficacy fades below eGFR 45 while organ protection persists to dialysis initiation thresholds, a dissociation prescribers must internalise or they will stop organ drugs for glucose reasons that no longer apply.
steps.say: When kidneys fade, glucose effect leaves and organ protection stays; do not stop the drug for the wrong endpoint.

nodes.label: SGLT2 inhibitor started for diabetes, heart or kidney indication
Early eGFR dip of 3 to 5 ml per minute expected
Cardiorenal protection continues to low eGFR thresholds

steps.tx: The **SGLT2 inhibitor** safety drills from earlier modules bear collecting: sick day pauses in dehydrating illness, perioperative withholding against euglycaemic ketoacidosis, foot vigilance where amputation signals were debated (canagliflozin's CANVAS signal not reproduced class wide), Fournier gangrene as a rare labelled horror, and genital hygiene counselling that prevents most mycotic misery. Fractures and bladder signals vary by agent and remain surveillance items rather than class verdicts.
steps.say: Sick days paused, surgery withheld, feet watched, hygiene counselled: the class drill in one breath.

left.title: Routine drills
points: Pause in vomiting, diarrhoea or poor intake
Withhold days before major surgery
Genital hygiene and early thrush treatment
Volume review in elderly and loop diuretic users

right.title: Rare but labelled
points: Euglycaemic ketoacidosis in illness or fasting
Fournier gangrene: perineal pain is an emergency
Amputation signal debated, foot care universal
Ketones checked in any sick SGLT2 patient

steps.tx: **Acarbose** inhibits intestinal alpha glucosidases, delaying carbohydrate digestion so postprandial glucose flattens while undigested starch ferments downstream into the flatulence, bloating and diarrhoea that limit it to the motivated. Taken with the first bite, useless without carbohydrate aboard, and hypoglycaemia on combination therapy must be treated with glucose, not sucrose, because the enzyme that frees glucose from sucrose is the one inhibited, a delicious examination trap.
steps.say: Acarbose trades postprandial peaks for flatulence, and its hypoglycaemia takes glucose, never table sugar.

left.title: Acarbose profile
points: Alpha glucosidase inhibition in the brush border
With the first bite of each carbohydrate meal
Postprandial glucose targeted, HbA1c fall modest
Flatulence and diarrhoea dose limiting

right.title: Acarbose traps
points: Hypoglycaemia treated with glucose, not sucrose
Useless in low carbohydrate meals
Liver enzymes at high doses historically
Miglitol its absorbable cousin

steps.tx: **Pramlintide**, an amylin analogue, replaces the beta cell's other hormone: it slows gastric emptying, suppresses postprandial glucagon and enforces satiety as mealtime injections added to insulin in type 1 and insulin using type 2 diabetes, at the cost of severe hypoglycaemia risk when insulin doses are not cut by a third to a half at initiation. Its niche is narrow and largely North American, but its physiology (amylin is co secreted with insulin and deficient in type 1) is examinable endocrinology.
steps.say: Pramlintide replaces insulin's forgotten partner hormone; cut the insulin first or it will teach you why.

nodes.label: Insulin treated diabetes with postprandial excursions
Mealtime insulin cut by a third to a half

steps.tx: **Sequencing modern type** 2 therapy after metformin is now comorbidity led and this module can finally be read as one map: cardiovascular disease argues GLP 1 agonist or SGLT2 inhibitor, heart failure or kidney progression argues SGLT2 inhibitor first, weight argues GLP 1 based therapy, hypoglycaemia avoidance argues gliptins or either modern class, and cost argues sulfonylureas and pioglitazone where their risks permit. HbA1c targets individualise around the chosen agents, not the reverse.
steps.say: Comorbidity chooses the second drug now; glucose arithmetic merely schedules the rest.

vis.caption: The full antidiabetic target map across which modern comorbidity led sequencing is chosen.

steps.tx: **Injectable escalation beyond orals** follows failure honestly defined: basal insulin added to orals (bedtime basal, fasting titration) before premixed or basal bolus complexity, GLP 1 agonists often preceding insulin where weight and hypoglycaemia argue, and fixed ratio basal GLP 1 combinations simplifying the union. Sulfonylureas are usually retired as insulin arrives, metformin and organ protective classes continue, and gliptins stop when GLP 1 therapy starts, the module's rules converging without contradiction.
steps.say: Basal before bolus, GLP 1 before insulin where weight argues, and retire the secretagogue as insulin lands.

nodes.label: Bedtime basal insulin or GLP 1 step chosen by phenotype
Mealtime insulin added stepwise if control still fails

steps.tx: **Monitoring binds the modern** classes: HbA1c every three to six months against individualised targets, eGFR and potassium trajectories on SGLT2 and RAAS partners, eye surveillance where rapid improvement threatens retinopathy, foot and genital reviews by class, and annual structured complication screening whatever the regimen. The pharmacology of this module changed faster in a decade than any other in the syllabus; the monitoring habits are what keep that speed safe at clinic pace.
steps.say: Fast moving classes, slow careful monitoring; kidneys, eyes, feet and genitals by drug name.

left.title: By class surveillance
points: SGLT2: eGFR dip then slope, genital and foot review
GLP 1: gastrointestinal tolerance, gallbladder symptoms
Sulfonylureas: hypoglycaemia diary and driving
Metformin: B12 and eGFR by band

right.title: Universal surveillance
points: HbA1c against individualised targets
Annual eye, foot, renal and lipid screening
Sick day rules documented for all
Cardiovascular risk factors treated in parallel
